attributes.board_name: Wisconsin Board of Nursing (Department of Safety and Professional Services)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Clinical pharmacology or therapeutics relevant to the APRN's area of practice

topics.who: All APRNs: responsible prescribing of controlled substances (part of the 16 hours)

rules.alternatives: Renewal also requires current national certification and current liability insurance (DSPS renewal documents list).
rules.notes: 16 contact hours per biennium in clinical pharmacology or therapeutics, at least 2 of them in responsible prescribing of controlled substances. National certification and liability insurance must be current at renewal.
rules.rule_quote: Every advanced practice registered nurse shall complete 16 contact hours per biennium in clinical pharmacology or therapeutics relevant to the advanced practice registered nurse's area of practice, including at least 2 contact hours in responsible prescribing of controlled substances.
